generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI simulator under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It accepts the required `--input` / `--output` interface, supports optional tool/parameter/probe/trace arguments, writes JSON output and trace files, and builds with an empty `[dependencies]` table.

Verification: `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. I also smoke-tested linear motion tracing, canned-cycle tracing, unit switching, and an error-path trace case with `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- ...`.

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
